observed_failure.purpose: Attempted presentation rendering of the preserved Claude DOCX evidence.

termination.stage: macOS application registration before document rendering

stop_rule.policy: An application abort or repeatable helper crash is a stop condition and must not be retried.

side_effect_audit.repository_effect: No repository mutation or document lock attributable to the failed helper was observed. The worktree already contained intentional implementation changes.

limitations: The receipt records the visible macOS translated crash report and a post-crash process, lock and source-hash audit; it is not a LibreOffice vendor root-cause analysis.
The source DOCX remains immutable evidence. Direct extraction is permitted, but generated renderings must be separate derived artefacts.
